decision_contract: QA-DOCKER-CONFIG-PREFLIGHT-01 -> main install-image/install_control_image/_install_locked/_run -> personal configuration or helper/proxy/context leakage -> approve only the frozen installer fix if config binding, early refusal, cleanup and retained build uncertainty hold.

original_blocker.reason: Every installer subprocess now selects its fresh anonymous config through --config and matching HOME/DOCKER_CONFIG. The caller's HOME is not lost into an NSS/personal-home fallback. Ambient DOCKER_* remains forbidden before Docker. The old BLOCKED_PREFLIGHT attempt is preserved; this does not promote that attempt or the old wheel to PASS.
original_blocker.next: Parent must adjudicate complementary reviews, build/read back the new CLI artifact and use a fresh separately authorized QA root; no reuse/retry of the old blocked attempt.

reviewed_properties.property: Valid anonymous auth configuration suppresses default credential-helper discovery
reviewed_properties.evidence: Docker CLI v20.10.24 and v28.5.1 LoadFromReader retain the nonempty auth map and add ServerAddress without username/password/token. ContainsAuth is TRUE because len(AuthConfigs)>0; therefore LoadDefaultConfigFile skips DetectDefaultStore. GetCredentialsStore selects file storage because credsStore/credHelpers are absent. v27.5.1 loader independently checked to match the installed client generation. Empty auths would not have this property. This is source-established semantics, not a live credential-manager exercise.

reviewed_properties.property: Exact private state selection, including ordinary CLI plugin chain
reviewed_properties.evidence: Only PATH is inherited. HOME and DOCKER_CONFIG equal the same generated directory passed by --config; XDG/proxy/BUILDX and other caller variables are absent. Public Docker plugin manager forwards original global argv and inherits the sanitized environment; personal plugin paths are under the private config, with only system plugin directories remaining. Buildx config source uses BUILDX_CONFIG or Docker config filename parent/buildx; BUILDX_CONFIG is stripped. BuildKit auth provider uses the supplied ConfigFile.GetAuthConfig, not an independent personal store. Trusted installed system plugins and PATH remain operator TCB, not arbitrary-plugin confinement.

reviewed_properties.property: Fresh owned configuration stays outside sealed and staged build contexts and through synchronous child execution
reviewed_properties.evidence: private_dir validates absolute canonical private parent and ancestors before tempfile creation. TemporaryDirectory creates 0700 fresh state; config creation is exclusive 0600 and closed before spawn. All bundle call sites use releases/ as parent; native build uses omnis/ above staged inputs. The context manager encloses subprocess.run. Cleanup never selects an existing operator directory or another generated name. Unit controls exercise success, spawn exception and timeout in both cwd categories.

reviewed_properties.property: No late allow after refusal, no automatic retry after uncertain image effect
reviewed_properties.evidence: Only private default context accepted; unsafe/missing canonical socket remains refusal and all effectful commands retain verified --host. Existing receipt/daemon identity comparisons are unchanged. Build timeout leaves intent with no successful receipt; subsequent public main install-image refuses without another build. Config creation failure and unsafe/symlinked parent separately proved zero child invocation. Cleanup failure propagates rather than turning into success.

proposed_parent_lesson: For anonymous Docker clients, --config alone or an empty auths map does not suppress automatic credential-helper discovery. Bind HOME and DOCKER_CONFIG as well, retain a finite nonempty anonymous auth entry, inspect normal plugin forwarding, and distinguish client-state cleanup from unresolved image/build intent. Parent owns any procedure update; reviewer made none.
